title: UrbanGym
description: UrbanGym at Trident Gymnastics Ringwood — gymnastics fundamentals, safe flipping and tricking, plus vaults, swings and creative movement, all coached.
blurb: Urban-inspired movement training that builds gymnastics fundamentals, safe flipping and tricking, plus vaults, swings and creative movement in a coached environment.

levels.name: UrbanGym Beginner
levels.description: Build strong movement foundations through safe landings, hand support, basic vaults and swings, and core gymnastics-style movement.

levels.name: UrbanGym Intermediate
levels.description: Progress into controlled flipping and linking, with a focus on cleaner take-offs and landings, flowing movement sequences, and confidence across obstacles.

levels.name: UrbanGym Advanced
levels.description: Develop advanced flipping, power and precision, combining complex movement patterns with creativity, control and style.
